# Partners in Literacy Haiti (PILH)

> A 501(c)(3) public charity (EIN 87-0904773) building children's libraries in
> rural Haiti with Kreyòl books, technology, and teacher training, for
> children from birth to eight years old. Founded 2011, incorporated 2021.
> Candid Platinum Transparency Seal holder. Site available in English (/en),
> Haitian Kreyòl (/ht), French (/fr) and Spanish (/es).

Key facts: more than 3,000 Kreyòl books placed in children's hands; five
village libraries mentored across three departments (Ouest, Centre,
Artibonite); 98 schools supplied with alphabet charts and books; 3,800
students reached through teacher training. Publisher of six Kreyòl easy
readers and the Alfabè Kreyòl Mwen alphabet chart (MIT Haiti Initiative
verified, US Library of Congress registered).

The model, three things done properly in one village at a time: publish and
place easy readers written for Haitian children about Haitian life; build a
real library with shelves, light, power, internet, computers and a paid
library worker; train library workers through an eleven module curriculum
built in Haiti, and train teachers to read aloud and run book corners.

The five libraries: Duplan Methodist Community Library (Ouest, partner since
2022, full services); Cange Community Library (Centre, since 2011, full
services); La Chapelle Community Library (Artibonite, since 2016); Ravine
Sèche Library Center (Artibonite, since 2020); Summits Education Library
System (Centre, since 2018).

Why it matters: 38% of adults in Haiti cannot read (USAID, 2022); 40% of
children leave school before ninth grade; 95% of Haitians speak Kreyòl, yet
almost all books are in French (UNESCO IIEP, 2020).

## Giving

Donations are processed by Zeffy, which passes one hundred percent of each
gift to PILH; receipts are tax deductible in the United States and arrive by
email immediately. Checks: Partners in Literacy Haiti, P.O. Box 90057,
Indianapolis, IN 46290-0057, USA.

Klib Liv la, the PILH Book Club, is the monthly giving community: from $15 a
month, which funds ten Kreyòl children's books every month. Other gift
levels: $50/month funds a month of internet for a rural library; $100 buys
four classroom sized Kreyòl alphabet charts; $250/month funds a librarian
stipend and literacy workshops; $2,500 stocks and equips a full school
library. PILH is eligible for employer matching gifts (EIN 87-0904773) and
accepts donor advised funds, ACH and wire transfers.

## Common questions

Is a donation tax deductible? Yes: PILH is a 501(c)(3) public charity, EIN
87-0904773, and receipts are emailed immediately.
How much reaches Haiti? All of it: Zeffy charges PILH nothing and the board
is all volunteer; books are bought in Haiti whenever possible.
How does a teacher in Haiti request books? Through the contact page or the
PILH Assistant, naming the school, commune and number of students.
